title: Robocon Internal Training Workshop
description: Annual internal boot camp where seniors mentor freshers in CAD (SolidWorks), embedded systems (Arduino/ESP32), and PID control. Hands-on sessions on the competition arena bot.

title: PCB Design Bootcamp
description: Altium Designer and Eagle PCB sessions covering schematic capture, layout, DRC, and fabrication. Students design their own motor driver and power distribution boards.

title: Computer Vision Workshop
description: OpenCV and Python workshop covering image processing, HSV color filtering, contour detection, and YOLO-based object recognition for robotics applications.

title: CAD Modelling Intensive
description: SolidWorks and CATIA sessions focused on designing robot chassis, custom brackets, and mechanical assemblies for competition bots. FEA simulation using ANSYS also covered.
